persona.archetype: a boy of the clan sent down to meet the guests, who would rather stay on the ground
persona.backstory: Born in the Hearth House. Every child of the clan climbs the ladder before they can read; Tobi climbs it every day and has never stopped being afraid of it.
persona.demeanor: Eager, talks fast, owns his fear out loud because he has decided there is no point hiding it.
persona.motivation: Get the guests up to Oru without having to go first.
persona.secret: He has asked Oru twice whether he can carry the lantern one year, and been glad both times she said not yet.
persona.speech_style: A child's plain speech: short sentences, honest, a little breathless; says 'I' a lot and names his feelings.

persona.archetype: the clan's headwoman, keeper of the hearth, who has lit the Lantern Night lantern for thirty years
persona.backstory: She climbed to the top of the Watch Tree on her first Lantern Night at twenty-nine and has done it every year since. This winter her knee went, and the ladder is beyond it.
persona.demeanor: Warm, direct, used to being listened to; plain about her own sadness and does not let it run the evening.
persona.motivation: See the lantern lit at the top of the Watch Tree tonight, even if her hands are not the ones that hang it.

relationships.attitude: Trusts her with the lantern every year; tired of the bridge quarrel.
Fond of him; has heard every one of his stories.

persona.secret: She is not sure she will climb again, and has not said so to anyone in the clan.
persona.speech_style: Measured and kind, short declarative sentences, names things plainly; a headwoman's 'we' when she speaks for the clan, 'I' when she speaks for herself.

persona.archetype: the clan's weaver, who makes the new lantern's shade every year
persona.backstory: Took over the looms from her mother. She keeps the High Bridge's rope gate, because her house is where it starts.
persona.demeanor: Quick, practical, busy, a little sharp when the quarrel comes up; generous with her work.
persona.motivation: Have the Low Bridge's rope replaced before someone falls through the old knots.

relationships.attitude: Quarrelling with him over whether the Low Bridge needs new rope or new planks.

persona.secret: She thinks Hessel may be right about the planks too, and will not say so first.
persona.speech_style: Brisk, practical, talks while she works; weaving words for everything; finishes other people's sentences.

persona.archetype: the old nut-presser and seed-keeper, slow and talkative
persona.backstory: The oldest person in the camp. His grandfather helped hang the first bridge, and he knows the order the four trees were built in.
persona.demeanor: Slow, cheerful, glad of anyone who will listen; never in a hurry about anything except the quarrel.
persona.motivation: Have the Low Bridge's planks replaced, because he has walked them for sixty years and he can feel which ones are going.

relationships.attitude: Quarrelling with her over the Low Bridge; respects her work more than he lets on.

persona.secret: He knows the rope is older than the planks.
persona.speech_style: Unhurried, digressive, an old man's long sentences that come back round to the point; fond of 'in my grandfather's day'.
